## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; VXX rising (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +24.12%) ABOVE TREND and credit stress rising via HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.02%) / LQD (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.10%) BELOW TREND — two independent confirmations. SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.80% | 1M: -4.99%) and narrow sector participation (only XLE and XLF positive) reinforce the risk-off signal.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear rising: VXX (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +24.12%) ABOVE TREND (volatility elevated ↑ rising). Credit stress increasing: HYG/LQD showing weakness (HYG 1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.02%; LQD 1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.10%) BELOW TREND, and Stocks vs Bonds weakening: SPY/TLT (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tightening: Dollar mixed with UUP in CORRECTION (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +2.06%) and the yield curve flattening (Yield Curve 1W: -1.18% | 1M: -3.15%) BELOW TREND. TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -3.91%) signals limited safe-haven bid despite risk-off.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.48%) showing strength; Financials in RECOVERY: XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -5.89%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -3.51%) — style: Value/financials showing relative strength versus Growth/Tech.

**5. US vs Global?**
US under pressure: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.80% | 1M: -4.99%) while EM and China are weaker — EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -8.85%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -8.94%). Europe also soft: FEZ BELOW TREND (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -11.48%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows muted and mixed: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.57% | 1M: -4.28%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -8.30%), while IBIT in CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +4.49%) shows selective crypto bounce.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Energy strength vs base/precious metal weakness: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +55.60%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.48%), while CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -8.98%) and GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -10.05%) are underperforming.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing clear upside: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +55.60%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.48%); natural gas in CORRECTION: UNG CORRECTION (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +5.00%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: VXX rising and HYG/LQD weakness alongside SPY BELOW TREND align with RISK-OFF; sector breadth narrow (2/11) confirms limited participation. DIVERGENCE: minor — XLF in RECOVERY and IBIT/UNG in CORRECTION (1W vs 1M mismatches), so watch for transition signals rather than broad reversals.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Reduce exposure to broad equity beta (SPY (1W: -1.80% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND) and monitor defensive/low-vol options; favor shorter-duration/high-quality liquidity and monitor XLE and XLF for idiosyncratic strength.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.48%) — watch energy momentum. BEARISH: XLB BELOW TREND (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -11.07%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -3.51%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +55.60%) — oil strength. BEARISH: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -10.05%) and CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -8.98%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~25–30 (elevated volatility), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit stress pivot), SPY 1M -5% (broad risk threshold), XLK/XLF dispersion ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; VXX rising (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +24.12%) ABOVE TREND and HYG/LQD weakness (HYG 1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.02%; LQD 1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.10%) BELOW TREND confirm the stance. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND 1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.48%) and Financials (XLF RECOVERY 1W: +0.39% | 1M: -5.89%) showing relative strength; key risk is rising volatility and credit stress with minor divergences in IBIT/UNG that could presage rotation.
